blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createOrderLineItemTaxLines` method. This belongs to the Order Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method creates line item tax lines.

blocks.html: This method creates a line item tax line.

```ts
const lineItemTaxLines = await orderModuleService
  .createOrderLineItemTaxLines({
    code: "123",
    rate: 2
  })
```
